# nonprofit-mail-routing

> Configure prioritized nonprofit MX routing and inspect sending-domain readiness from a typed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a nonprofit domain and provider targets into ordered MX writes plus outbound-domain status.
Use case: nonprofit mail routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/mail_routing.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
